title: Correct git reference matching per issue
objective: Make the per-issue git section match reality: commits that reference the issue ID anywhere in the message (not only the subject), case-insensitively, as a fixed string, and without substring bleed between IDs such as bd-123 matching bd-1234; branch matching gets the same boundary rule; record parsing becomes delimiter-based instead of a hand-rolled line scanner.
acceptance_criteria: A commit whose message references the ID only in the body is listed (regression verified against b9ee821 and fa53cae in this repository).
Matching is case-insensitive and treats the ID as a literal, so IDs containing regex metacharacters such as dots are safe.
bd-123 does not match bd-1234 in commit messages or branch names; IDs glued to other alphanumerics are rejected while trailing punctuation or separators still match.
Commit records are parsed from a delimiter-separated format with no subject-only re-confirmation.
Matcher and parser are covered by unit tests, and swift build plus git diff --check pass.
